newsitem.title: CANADA: Norcen, Shell say not mulling Morrison bid.
newsitem.headline: Norcen, Shell say not mulling Morrison bid.

text.p: Norcen Energy Resources Ltd and Shell Canada Ltd, top deep natural gas exploreres in southwestern Alberta, said on Monday they were not considering launching rival bids for Morrison Petroleums Ltd.
"I just heard about this thing this morning. We really haven't considered that at all," said Doug Palmer, Norcen's chief operating officer.
Norcen is a partner of Morrison's in deep gas exploration in the southwestern Alberta foothills, where Canadian 88 made a major discovery last year.
Morrison is the target of a C$652-million cash and stock takeover bid from Canadian 88 Energy Corp announced on Monday.
Cash-rich Shell Canada, known as the premier deep gas player in southwestern Alberta, was also speculated as a potential white knight.

"If the rumor and anticipation is that we would be in there for a rival bid, all I can say to you for right now is that's market speculation," said Shell Canada vice-president Ron Blakely. "I can never, ever rule anything out, but this this morning is kind of news to us like it's news to everybody else."
Morrison Petroleums shares in afternoon trade were up C$1.50 to C$10 on volume of 13.3 million shares. Canadian 88 was down C$30 to C$6.45.
